title: Written Estimate for a Repeat Repair — Service Accounts and Repair Orders Estimate Policy
content:
**Policy.** This policy prices the written estimate for a diagnosed concern line whose failure repeats the latest customer-pay parts repair recorded on the same vehicle; the estimate is the customer-pay labor and parts amount the customer authorizes, before shop fees. It applies to diagnosed concern lines on Service Accounts and Repair Orders accounts.

**Recording.** The estimate is recorded as the customer's own authorized decision on the diagnosed concern line, dated on the day the customer gives it. Recording the decision posts no charge.

## Tool: `authorize_repair_estimate_690e2aa2`
**Capability.** The account holder authorizes the written estimate for one diagnosed concern line of their repair order at the stated customer-pay amount; one call records the customer's own decision as an authorized estimate decision for that line, dated today. No charge is posted by the call.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `authorize_repair_estimate_690e2aa2` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | Reference number of the customer's service account, as returned by the service account lookup | Id |
| `repair_order_number` | Repair order number of the diagnosed line, copied from the repair order lines returned by the ledger lookup | Verbatim, character for character, no normalisation |
| `line_letter` | The concern line authorized | One of `A` (first concern line), `B`, `C`, `D`, `E`, `F`, `G`, `H` (eighth) |
| `estimate_amount` | Customer-pay amount of the written estimate being authorized (labor and parts, excluding shop fees) | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (further digits are rounded half up), greater than zero, plain decimal notation with no currency sign, separators or exponent |

**Return.** A one-line receipt beginning with the word Authorized, naming the authorization reference, the repair order number and concern line, the authorized estimate amount and the decision date (YYYY-MM-DD). A string beginning with Error is returned, and nothing is recorded, when `estimate_amount` is not a plain decimal amount greater than zero after rounding or `line_letter` is not one of A to H.
